modules.title: 17 components, one path for every call
modules.lede: Each component has one job. Open any one to see what it takes in, what it produces and how it recovers when something goes wrong. Maturity labels are as given in the product's own architecture.

items.name: Citizen call · Citizen / Incoming Call
items.summary: A citizen dials the control-room number to report an incident such as UPI fraud.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Every BluVaani journey starts with a real citizen contact, not a form.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Caller hangs up at once — spotted by short cdr / no answer — recovery: No case; optional callback

items.name: Phone system · Grandstream UCM PBX
items.summary: Receives control-room calls and routes them into the intake queue.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Central telephony control for police control-room numbers.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: PBX interruption — spotted by call-drop event / incomplete cdr — recovery: Mark interrupted, keep the partial CDR, prompt a redial

items.name: Intake queue · Queue 6500
items.summary: Holds incoming calls and hands each one to the AI line or an officer desk.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: AI unavailable / no agents — spotted by queue timeout — recovery: Overflow to officer desks or callback

items.name: AI call line · AI Ext 1007
items.summary: BluVaani answers first-line calls on extension 1007 and opens the audio to the understanding pipeline.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Scales first-line complaint capture with a consistent structure.

details.label: Produces
details.text: Audio stream; Answer details in CDR

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: AI line unreachable — spotted by extension unreachable — recovery: Reroute to officer desks 1001 / 1003 / 1004 / 1009

items.name: Officer desks · Human Exts 1001/1003/1004/1009
items.summary: Officers take escalations, unclear audio and complex calls.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Human judgement is always one step away.

items.name: Call records · CDR Collection
items.summary: Collects call detail records for operations and reporting.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Evidence of call handling, and the input to Call Operations reporting.

items.name: Listening · Speech Processing
items.summary: Prepares the call audio for transcription.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Turns voice into segments that can be processed.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Noisy or broken audio — spotted by low signal quality — recovery: Flag clarity; hand off to an officer if needed

items.name: Speech to text · Transcription
items.summary: Turns speech into a transcript with a confidence score.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Text makes classification and case drafting possible.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Unclear transcription — spotted by low confidence score — recovery: Officer-desk review before classification

items.name: Understanding · Intent & Classification
items.summary: Works out what the caller needs and what type of complaint it is.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Separates enquiries, non-financial complaints and fraud complaints.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: AI processing failure — spotted by pipeline error — recovery: Retry, then hand off to an officer desk

items.name: Fraud & loss check · Financial Fraud Qualification
items.summary: Separates general complaints from confirmed financial fraud, then confirms whether money was actually lost.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Case type, officer priority and WhatsApp automation all depend on it.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Details incomplete — spotted by amount / method / reference missing — recovery: Case held as pending_info for follow-up

items.name: Case record · Case Management
items.summary: Creates and tracks the structured case, links calls to it and holds its status.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: The operational system of record for every complaint.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Same incident reported twice — spotted by duplicate detection — recovery: Linked to the existing case; no second intake

items.name: WhatsApp follow-up · WhatsApp Automation
items.summary: Sends the acknowledgement and financial-fraud intake message, only when all three conditions are true.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Keeps the citizen informed after the call without a manual send.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Gateway offline, or delivery fails — spotted by send blocked / failed delivery — recovery: Queued for retry; the case stays valid

items.name: Officer review · Police Operations
items.summary: Officers review the structured case, update its status and follow up.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Turns structured intake into police action.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Case not yet reviewed — spotted by status pending_officer — recovery: Shown in the Pending Work & Aging report

items.name: NCRP filing · NCRP Integration
items.summary: The officer uploads the Excel filing; the outcome syncs back to the same case.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Connects local casework to NCRP filing outcomes.

details.label: When something goes wrong
details.text: Filing rejected — spotted by rejection on sync — recovery: Case set to correction_required; police notified

items.name: Backend services · Backend Services (logical)
items.summary: The service layer between the screens, the automation and the adapters.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Lets simulated adapters be swapped for real APIs later.

items.name: Data store · Data Store (logical)
items.summary: Keeps call records, cases, messages and filings in one place.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Shared data for every component and every report.

details.label: Takes in
details.text: CDR rows; Case entities; Message status

items.name: Reports · Analytics & Reporting
items.summary: Rolls call, case, WhatsApp and NCRP signals into seven reports.

details.label: Why it exists
details.text: Leaders and officers see the whole lifecycle.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html:
One citizen call. Understood, recorded, acted on.

A fraud victim calls once. The system must not lose a word. BluVaani answers the call in any Indian language the citizen speaks, separates who said what, works out what happened and how urgent it is, and turns the call into a structured case that someone is accountable for.

The journey · nineteen stages, phone ringing to a line in a report

  1. AnswerThe call is picked up in any Indian language the citizen uses, including mixed speech.
  2. TranscribeSpeech to text, with speakers separated so the officer's words and the citizen's are distinct.
  3. UnderstandIntent, urgency, place and names extracted; emergencies jump the queue on urgency score.
  4. DispatchRouted to the right station, unit or patrol based on jurisdiction and availability.
  5. Hand offComplaint passed to the documentation product, the grievance board or a field task.

The follow-up rule

Three conditions · all true, or no message A follow-up message is never sent automatically

The messaging follow-up is deliberately conditional, not a blanket auto-reply. All three conditions must hold before anything leaves the platform. This is the rule as the product implements it, and it should not be described as generic automatic messaging.

  • The call is classified as a financial-fraud or money-loss case under the decision logic.
  • The caller's number is captured and valid for the messaging channel.
  • The case reaches the state at which a follow-up is defined as appropriate.

What the department gets

Structured cases

Every call becomes a case with a transcript, a summary, a classification and a dispatch decision attached.

Clean statuses

One status at a time, always a clear answer — including what happens when a call is not the happy path.

Seven operational reports

Call volumes, categories, urgency bands, dispatch outcomes, handoffs, follow-ups and closure, counted from the case record.

Safeguards

  • Fast for the citizen, careful for the department — urgency decides the queue, not call order alone.
  • Human handoff — an officer reviews before a case leaves the call-handling stage.
  • Transcript retained — the summary never replaces the record it came from.
  • Local deployment option — speech and language models can run inside the department's own infrastructure.
